treatments.label: Launch Legal Ethics Assessment & Diagnostics Feedback Loop Design
treatments.description: Launch a judicial efficiency improvement for legal ethics assessment & diagnostics implementing NCSC CourTools performance measures with case management reform.
treatments.cite: UNODC (2023). Global Study on Homicide. UNODC; Rawls, J. (1971). A Theory of Justice. Harvard University Press
steps: Assess court performance for legal ethics assessment & diagnostics using NCSC CourTools baseline measurement
Design case management reform with time standards and differentiated case tracks
Implement electronic case management system with workflow automation
Deploy performance dashboards with judge-level and court-level metrics
Evaluate through clearance rate, time-to-disposition, and age of pending cases
treatments.monitoring: PHASE 1 (Weeks 1-4): Baseline — case clearance rate using court management information system. Deliverable: baseline report. PHASE 2 (Months 2-3): Early tracking — case clearance rate measured monthly. Target: clearance rate above 100%. PHASE 3 (Months 4-6): Midpoint review — compare against NCSC CourTools benchmark. Target: 50% of goal. PHASE 4 (Months 7-12): Maturation — case clearance rate trending toward rate above 110%. Escalate if <rate above 90% floor. ANNUAL REVIEW: Comprehensive audit using NCSC CourTools framework. Report to Chief Justice.
treatments.escalation: If target outcome shows no measurable improvement after 90 days, or if implementation barriers prevent protocol adherence for >14 consecutive days, escalate to a legal profession regulation specialist for root cause analysis and intervention redesign. If the intervention produces adverse unintended effects at any point, pause implementation and request specialist review within 14 days.
